If both P,N<m=min_i|x_i|, all |y_i|<|x_i| on nonzero coordinates and P+N=||y||1=1<2m<=2/n<=1, contradiction. Thus max chord<=2 and min chord<=2(1-m). Choosing y at an index of minimum modulus attains (2,2(1-m)). For infinite I, inf_i|x_i|=0 and coordinate-unit witnesses yield sup 2. Handles t<0,t=0,t=-infty by monotone generalized means.
